# Generated Files

What Octopus creates, and which command owns each file. YAML/JSON is the source
of truth; Markdown files are generated views.

## Root planning artifacts

| File | Written by | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `requirements.md` | `plan` | Requirements summary |
| `ml_design.md` | `ml-plan` | Problem framing, baseline/candidate models, training strategy |
| `experiment_plan.md` | `ml-plan` | Baseline, experiment queue, stop conditions |
| `data_strategy.md` | `ml-plan` | Split, leakage, quality checks |
| `compute_budget.md` | `ml-plan` | Resource profile and budget |
| `tasks.md` | `tasks` | Human-readable task view |
| `CLAUDE.md` | `init`/`sync` | Claude Code project instructions (if runtime includes claude) |
| `AGENTS.md` | `init`/`sync` | Codex/agent project instructions (if runtime includes codex) |

## `.octopus/` state

```text
.octopus/
  config.yaml              # version, runtime, timestamps           (init)
  project_state.json       # ProjectState (source of truth)         (ask)
  tasks.json               # managed task state + dependency gates  (tasks)
  context/
    current_context.md     # compact task/direction context         (context)
  experiments/
    index.yaml             # latest_id, best_experiment_id, main_metric
    E001.yaml, ...         # ingested runs (new IDs)                 (exp ingest)
    exp_001.yaml, ...      # legacy logged runs                      (exp log)
  reports/
    baseline_profile.md    # baseline understanding + techniques     (exp profile)
    training_review_*.md   # per-run diagnosis                       (exp analyze)
    experiment_report.md   # overall report                          (exp report)
  plans/
    next_steps.md / .yaml  # ranked next directions                  (exp next)
    selected_direction.yaml# chosen direction                        (exp choose)
  memory/
    experiments.md         # long-term run memory
    best_runs.md           # best runs
    failures.md            # failed directions (avoided by next)
    decisions.md           # selected decisions
  session/
    current.json / .md     # active short-term session               (session)
    <session_id>.json      # archived sessions                       (session end)
  adr/                     # architecture decision records
```

## Runtime artifacts (from `install`)

```text
~/.claude/commands/octopus-*.md      # 6 slash command routers
~/.claude/agents/octopus-*.md        # 5 subagents
~/.claude/settings.json              # baseline-guard PreToolUse hook (merged)
~/.claude/.octopus-manifest.json     # install manifest
~/.codex/skills/octopus-baseline/    # Codex skill for baseline workflow
~/.codex/prompts/octopus-*.md        # 6 prompt routers
~/.codex/.octopus-manifest.json      # install manifest
```

Not generated by Octopus (gitignored): `tests/datasets/` (benchmark data) is not
committed; fetch it separately to run the benchmarks.
